div.head: II Cn 68
div.ab: ⁊ utan don, swa us þearf is, helpan áá þam raþost, þe helpes betst behofað; þonne nime we þæs lean, þær us leofast byð.
And uton don, swa us ðearf is, helpan æfre ðam raðost, ðe helpes behofoð.
⁊ uton don, swa us þearf is, helpan áá þam raðost, þe helpes best beofað; þonne lése we þæs lean, þær us leofast byð.
Et faciamus, sicut nobis expedit: succurramus semper ei primitus, qui magis indiget; tunc metemus inde mercedem nostram, ubi nobis carius erit;
Faciamus etiam, ut nobis est ualde necessarium: semper succurramus ei cicius, qui succursu magis indiget; et accipiemus inde premium, ubi acceptabilius est.
And uton don, swa us ðearf is, helpan æfre ðam raðost ðe helpes behofoð; [þonne nime we þæs lean þær us leofast byð].
And utan don, swa us þearf is: helpan aa þam raþost þe helpes betst behofað; þonne nime we þæs lean, þær us leofast byð.
Und lasst uns handeln, wie uns Pflicht ist, immer demjenigen zunächst helfen, der zumeist Hilfe bedarf; dann werden wir dort dafür Lohn davontragen (einlesen A Quadr), wo es uns am werthvollsten ist.
And let us act as is our duty: always help first the one who most needs help; then we shall carry off (gather in, A, Quadr.) the reward for it there where it is most valuable to us.
And let us, as our duty is, ever render help with the utmost speed to those who require help; [then shall we receive the reward for so doing where we most desire it].
And let us do, as is profitable for us, always help quickest those who need it most; then shall we receive our reward for it where it will be most pleasing to us.
And let us do what is required of us: always aid as soon as possible those who most need our help; then we will receive the reward for that when it will be of greatest value to us.

note.label: left its mark on
note.quote: This passage is from the appendix to the version of Æthelred’s Enham decrees ... and it duly left its mark on the Winchester code.
